items.headline_english: Chathurya, keeping a balanced path between the arts and science
items.summary: A feature interview in the Sunday Silumina's Rasaduna supplement on how Chathurya balances her singing and screen work with her career in aerospace engineering, from her curiosity about technology as a child to her research on materials for space re-entry vehicles.
